pairDesign:
Create a cohesive ORIGINAL pair of warm Japanese chibi PIXEL-ILLUSTRATION characters, guided closely by the TWO attached reference sprite sheets in proportions, pixel clusters, facial appeal, hairstyle volume, fabric folds, restrained warm light and finished quality. This is a production source board for a modular 2D character tool, NOT a photo, vector art, soft 3D render, or a screenshot. Genuine transparent background; NEVER draw a checkerboard, labels, text, frames, ground shadows, interface or decoration.

Canvas layout: a spacious wide 4-column by 2-row grid, eight separated cells. All artwork must be fully visible with generous transparent spacing and no overlap.
TOP ROW is character "Theo": column 1 his complete full-body neutral standing figure, columns 2,3,4 three separate COMPLETE HEAD AND SHORT NECK states: neutral relaxed, warm gentle smile, joyful closed-eye open smile.
BOTTOM ROW is character "Rose": column 1 her complete full-body neutral standing figure, columns 2,3,4 three separate COMPLETE HEAD AND SHORT NECK states with ALL long hair, in the same three expressions.
These are the same two individuals in every repeated head. Identical head scale, hair silhouette, ear location, chin, neck base and three-quarter perspective across expressions; change eyes, brows, mouth and cheek together. No rectangular face replacements.

Theo matches the first reference's charm: tousled fluffy chestnut short hair with distinct swept clumps and small spikes, dark warm-brown lively eyes, warm peach skin, rounded cheeks and understated nose. Dark midnight navy tailored suit, ivory waistcoat and shirt, dusty rose tie, tiny rose-and-leaf boutonniere attached to lapel, brown leather shoes. His shoulders are compact and rounded. A short plausible neck sits between chin and collar. Calm standing pose with separate relaxed hands alongside body. No duplicate hands, no long skinny neck.
Rose matches the second reference's charm: long voluminous chestnut wavy hair with curved separated locks, side-swept fringe, small cream-and-coral flower clip with sage leaves above the near ear, warm brown eyes, warm peach skin. Coral knee-length flared dress, fitted bodice, ivory short puff sleeves, cream waist trim and a few small orderly skirt hem details, ivory socks, rounded brown shoes. A small tan crossbody satchel at the near hip with a narrow cream strap follows the torso; keep it modest and simple. Calm standing pose with arms slightly away from the torso so sleeves and neckline can be studied.

Art direction: sweet romantic cozy game sprites, about 2.5 heads tall, three-quarter view looking RIGHT. Large but readable expressive eyes with dark irises and very small crisp highlights. Tiny curved mouth, restrained blush. Rounded silhouettes and small hands. Follow the references' FULLY FINISHED PIXEL ART quality: crisp deliberate stair-step contours, small coherent color clusters, warm dark-brown outline, 4–6 tonal planes per material, clear curled hair sections with grouped highlights, believable tailored folds. Fabric is smooth grouped pixels with fold planes, NOT granular noise, speckled texture or dithering. No airbrush gradients or blurry anti-aliasing. Use the SAME painter/palette logic, outline weight, light from upper left and pixel density for hair, face, skin, clothing and shoes across both characters. Design each complete figure to remain legible when registered to a native 192x256 sprite canvas. Keep all hair and feet inside each cell. In detached heads show only the entire hair, face, ears and short neck, absolutely no shoulders, clothing or chest. No concepts pasted from references: draw this matched pair consistently.

Row1 col3: FAR FULL ARM, narrower matching shoulder-sleeve-cuff-relaxed hand. No other body pieces.

Row2 col3: FAR STRAIGHT TROUSER LEG, matching narrower perspective, same height and filled upper overlap. No shoes.

Keep the hand skin/color and outline treatment identical to the attached figure. Garments should use grouped 4–6 tone planes and intentional folds, NOT speckles. This sheet will be registered offline into a 192x256 character: draw complete solid underlying overlap around shoulder, elbow, wrist, hip and ankle, not missing fabric or disconnected outlines. Every pixel belongs to the named detached part. Do not include any bag, additional accessories, background or pose sketches.
